sourceScope: Owned R60 single-package embedded-chainer feasibility fixture. Not product app, broker, release or install acceptance.

entry.default: Without explicit ExecuteOwnedProbe the script refuses before installation. Root must independently inspect and provide exact pins; no SSH/copy/install command executed here.
operationOrder: only if needed and all prior physical operations resolved: exact own /x cleanup COMMIT
entry.options: Each /qn /norestart REBOOT=ReallySuppress and owned full MSI log. No visible prompt, restart or user desktop action intended.

inputScopeGuards: Only exact nonce-named directory directly under current TEMP; no reparse input directory/MSI/guardian.
Pinned guardian read-only query returns compiled fixed ProductCode+nonce; both must equal fixture.json before any MSI mutation, preventing a substituted JSON ProductCode selecting foreign software.
Only original synthetic product may be queried/repaired/removed; initial product state must be unknown.
Existing same-nonce HKCU root is refused, not adopted; original SID recorded and checked against actual guardian token SID.
HKCU root is a single new random leaf under existing Software, with no new FutureClassroom/Tests parent keys. Payload and evidence children disappear only with exact own leaf cleanup.

guardianWire.argument: Only engine-supplied transaction id, not a manufactured wrapper handle. ArgCount2 and bounded unsigned parse required.
guardianWire.nativeApis: MsiJoinTransaction(originalId,0,&ownerChangeEvent); MsiEndTransaction(COMMIT|ROLLBACK). The installed MinGW libmsi.a lacks their import thunks, so resolve exact names in already imported msi.dll; record export absence and fail, never simulate.
guardianWire.sources: Actual per-user token SID, original PID/GetProcessTimes creation time, requested mode, JoinReturn, owner event raw status, EndEntered/EndReturn/EndReturned, AboutToReturnCode in fixed own HKCU evidence key.
guardianWire.physicalObservation: Guardian emits ready then waits10000ms for observer ACK. Supervisor opens original Process HANDLE, checks creation time and actual extracted-image SHA before ACK. It later waits exact original guardian and msiexec physical exit; AboutToReturnCode is explicitly not physical exit.
guardianWire.readOnlyQueryRole: Same pinned GUI guardian --product-state calls only MsiQueryProductStateW for its compile-time random ProductCode and emits fixed JSON with compile-time nonce/productCode; stdout captured by original process pipes.
guardianWire.gui: Actual PE32 GUI subsystem2, no Alloc/Attach/FreeConsole/MessageBox or app-launch behavior.
guardianWire.ownerEvent: Recorded only; not interpreted as end/rollback complete.

observationsAndOutcomes.outcome: All native return codes, MSI client exit, original process identity, registered product state and owned DWORD readback retained verbatim. Native rollback installer return is not predeclared or rewritten.
observationsAndOutcomes.contractFlag: Only4 expected modes each with actual guardian process exit0, Join0+End0, expected registered state and marker readback can set directSinglePackageContractSatisfied. It is still a feasibility-only observation, not a product lifecycle guarantee.
observationsAndOutcomes.unknown: No EndReturn or nonzero End after entry, timeout, live original process, PID/creation/SID/hash uncertainty leaves unknownPhysicalOperation and disables further operations/cleanup. No shared msiserver termination; no kill command or unrelated product search. Root must keep original supervision and resolve exact owned process identities before further cleanup.
observationsAndOutcomes.cleanup: After all operations physically returned and known state: if own random product is registered, explicit own /x is attempted; only actual absence + exact nonce/SID marker allow removal of that single HKCU leaf. Unknown/other state retained. No Run, ProgramData, trust, services, firewall, network, foreign files or school data touched.
observationsAndOutcomes.report: Owned Temp windows-observations-first.json plus original MSI logs; report is exclusive, actual failure originals never overwritten.

staticProof.exactTable: One MsiEmbeddedChainer row, type2 Binary.Guardian, empty additional commandline. No extra payload package. Binary stream independently equals actual guardian PE.
staticProof.closedSideEffects: One own HKCU DWORD1 component, no installed File/CreateFolder, ordinary CustomAction, service, shortcut, RemoveFile, IniFile or Upgrade rows. Standard MSI product registration/ARP hidden markers still real and require uninstall cleanup.
staticProof.msiApiVersion: InstallerVersion500/Intel;1033, not a claim that Windows currently accepts guardian workflow.
